skill.displayName: Smart Web Monitor (智能网页监控)
skill.summary: Smart web monitor with AI-powered matching. Unlike keyword/regex monitors, this skill uses the agent's own LLM reasoning to evaluate whether a web page match...

latestVersion.changelog: 初版发布。AI-powered web monitor，支持关键词/正则/CSS/JSONPath/LLM 五种匹配模式。LLM 模式用 Agent 自然语言推理判断是否匹配，支持复杂条件如'是否有风控岗位？排除实习'。
